The prior REVISE's two targets are both gone: line 41's heading now reads '## Make Claude show its work, make it dig' (no 'honest'), and the two em-dashes that were at the old lines 85/87 ('**Reference** —' / '**plan.md** —') are now commas ('**Reference**, what the task is...' / '**plan.md**, the agent's working document...').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Zero hits for ritual/ceremony in body. 'exercise' used throughout for the activity itself; body has zero practice(n) uses (the three 'practice' hits in the file are all in the Sources block, below the maintainer cut).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for 2026-, caught live, compounded, restructure, extracted from, (MOVED, settled <date>, retired, historically, used to inside the body region returns zero hits (all matches in the file sit at line 155+, below the maintainer cut). Line 113's 'measured in words the prompt no longer needs' is present-tense description of what the packaged prompt lacks, not a changelog clause narrating how the file changed; passes the tense test (nothing actionable is lost if a reader never saw an earlier draft).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body reads Boris-direct/terse throughout ('You're diagnosing, not fixing', 'A built-but-untested verifier is no verifier') with Rory-adjacent aphorism on the thesis line ('packaging you built against your own failure beats packaging you guessed at'); no L&D-coach, motivational-poster, or Martin consulting-deck register found. Atmospheric-imagery scan: no isolation/darkness/sleep, body-state, or cosmic-scale metaphors present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise file, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named practitioner (Ronacher/Cherny/Kim/Klaassen/Huntley/Pocock) appears in body prose; the backing block's own stance note defers naming to the closing lecture on purpose. Author-we sub-check: body has exactly one first-person-plural token, line 70 'scoped to the task we ran un-packaged.' Diagnostic substitution ('the training authors ran un-packaged') reads as nonsense, not as the banned institutional sense, so this is the KEEP-listed student+Claude collective, not author-we proper; it also mirrors the fenced prompt's own opening clause one paragraph below ('Build the verifier for my dominant failure, scoped to the task we ran un-packaged'), which is itself legitimate under the fenced-prompt carve-out (check_prompts.md §38 rhyme). Closest-to-violating instance, and it stays inside: recasting only the body half to 'you' is a fair maintainer call, not a required fix, since the referent is unambiguous in context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for 'the student(s)', 'the trainer(s)', 'before students', 'say it plainly' in body returns zero hits. Second person carried throughout ('You're diagnosing...', 'Push back...', 'Read what Claude proposes...').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.

'Make Claude show its work, make it dig' (the Phase-1 sub-heading) uses 'make' and 'dig', neither of which is on the banned list.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Cold-read of every header against its section's claim: 'Check both files are for the agent, not you' is literally true (the section instructs pushing back if either file reads human-facing instead of agent-consumed); no spatial metaphor contradicting a mechanism, no unscoped 'other X' found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'That is the X' / 'This is the Y' deictic drumroll in body. The three Phase-3 verifier-shape bullets open on a new grammatical subject each time ('Separate Claude session reads...', 'Tests, lint, type-check...', 'Loop the prompt...'), not an echo of their own bold label. The five ', not ' pairs in body (diagnosing/fixing, data/blame, minutes/hours, agent/you, evidence/encouragement) are all meaningful contrasts against a real plausible misreading, not empty negation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
